tasks.CentroidAndOrthocenterProperties: Use properties of the centroid (G) and orthocenter (H) to find relationships involving F, the midpoint of GH.
tasks.DistanceFormulaApplication: Apply distance formula to calculate AF^2, BF^2, and CF^2 based on coordinates or vectors related to G, H, and F.
